content:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert - PAGER: Dedicated GPU pool 'reserved-eu-1' is at 98% reserved capacity. Queue growth +320% in 5m, token throttles active. Affected tenants: tenant-acme-inc (reserved), tenant-batchcorp (best-effort). Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1825067890

alice: oncall here, looking. paging infra +sre

dmitri: I'm up. grabbing graphs, what's the current autoscaler state?

ben: checking autoscaler logs now. initial quick grep:
```
$ kubectl -n inference get hpa reserved-eu-1
NAME            REFERENCE        TARGETS   MIN   MAX   REPLICAS
reserved-eu-1   Deployment/serve  98%       8     12    12
```
Seems max_replicas=12 hit.

carla: are reserved GPUs pinned to enterprise tenants? which tenant is using most?

infra-bot: Top consumers last 10m: tenant-acme-inc: 82% reserved GPU time, tenant-batchcorp: 11%, system: 7%.

alice: acme on reserved contract. their jobs look like long-lived beam/batch inference. They started a large rerun around ~02:10 UTC.

dmitri: ok. mitigation options: 1) increase HPA max_replicas (region quota check), 2) enable burst pool for enterprise (if available), 3) throttle per-tenant concurrency for non-critical jobs, 4) migrate some acme jobs to dedicated-burst-2 (manual)

ben: trying option 1 now. increasing max to 18.
```
$ kubectl -n inference patch hpa reserved-eu-1 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":18}}'
patched
```

infra-bot: Quota check: current GPU quota in eu-west-3 allows 14 additional GPUs. Allocation request accepted, but control-plane autoscale delay ~90s.

alice: starting per-tenant throttle for tenant-batchcorp and batch job queue for acme. Carving: set tenant-acme-inc concurrency=6 -> was 20.

carla: command?

ben: run:
```
$ rwoodctl tenants throttle set --tenant tenant-acme-inc --concurrency 6
Success: tenant-acme-inc throttle applied
```

eve: FYI CS: pinging account team, acme may see higher latencies or partial queueing.

cs-rep: notified Acme account owner, drafting workaround note. Also opening support ticket ref: #INC-1825067890

dmitri: monitoring queue: open requests in reserved queue dropped from 5k -> 1.2k in 6m. Latency p95 reduced 40%.

alice: handing off to dmitri for follow-up. I'm offline in ~10. @dmitri take lead.

dmitri: taking lead. setting incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will keep thread updated. Plan: 1) keep throttle for 30m, 2) monitor for requeue, 3) follow up with infra to consider higher steady-state cap for reserved-eu-1.

ben: we also found a noisy tenant job tag 'acme-snapshot-reindex' - we've isolated and set low priority. Suggest a postmortem to review runaway batch jobs and reservation isolation.

carla: agree. I'll start postmortem doc and include suggested guardrails (per-tenant burst limits, auto-priority decay, alert on sustained >75% reserved usage for 3m).

alice: thanks team. can someone confirm customer-facing message content when CS publishes?

cs-rep: Draft: "We're aware of elevated latency for some enterprise workloads in eu-west-3 between 02:00-03:00 UTC. Mitigation applied; queue draining. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Sending to acme now.

infra-bot: At 1825068120, GPU allocation scaled from 12 -> 18. New replica health: 18/18 ready.

dmitri: queue at 280 remaining, throttles still active. setting check @ 1825068810 (10m).

eve: adding retrospective note to oncall handoff doc.

dmitri: closing on-call handoff: incident mitigated, monitoring-only. Will open follow-up ticket for quota + guardrails.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged and marked resolved in PagerDuty. Incident: PAGER-1825067890
